paite: Moab tungtang thu; sepaihte’ TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: "Nebo tung agik hi; hihgawp in a-omta; Kiriathaim zahlaksak in a- omta, laksuan ahi. Misgab bel zahlak leh hihsiat in a-omta.
heading: Moab Suksiatna
english: Of Moab. Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Woe to Nebo! for it is laid waste; Kiriathaim is disappointed, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

paite: Moab minthanna amangta; Heshbon ah asiatna ding gen in, 'Kisa un, nam ahihna kipan i hihmang ding uh,' " achi ua. Aw Madmen khua, nang leng daihsak sipsip na hi ding a, namsau in ahon delh ding.
english: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. You also, Madmen, shall be brought to silence: the sword shall pursue you.

paite: Horonaim a kipan akikou husa, lohna leh siatna thupi mahmah.
english: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

paite: Moab suksiat ahi a, atate kap ging zak in a-om hi,
english: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

paite: Luhith ah kap in apaitou ua, Horonaim sul ah manthatna kikou ging lunglelhhuai aza uh.
english: For by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping shall they go up; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

paite: Taimang unla, na hinna uh humbit un, gamdai gam sabiltung bang in om un.
english: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

paite: Na nasep leh na sum-le-pai na muan ziak in nang leng mat in na om ding hi, Khemosh sal a pi ahi ding; asiampute leh aheutute toh.
english: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also shall be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

paite: Kho chih ah hihsemi ahong tung ding, kho khat lel in leng apel kei ding; phaizang gam leng amang ding; phaizang hihsiat ahi ding. TOUPA'N achihsa bang in.
english: The destroyer shall come on every city, and no city shall escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed; as Yahweh has spoken.

paite: Alenmang theihna ding in Moab kha pia un, tengmi om lou in, akhuate akisegawp ding.
english: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get her away: and her cities shall become a desolation, without any to dwell therein.

paite: Limsak loutak a Pathian nna semmi hamsethuak in om henla, sisan suah ding a anamsau zang nuamloumi hamsethuak in om hen.
english: Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

paite: Atuailai a kipan Moab in nuam asa a, a-uain abohkhum a, bel dang a teituah leng atuak kei a, sal a pi in a-om ngei sam kei hi, alim ngeingei a lim gige in, agim leng alamdang tuan kei.
heading: Moab Khopite Siatna
english: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.

paite: "Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, abungkhe ding mi ka hon sawl ding a, huan amau abungkhe ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; abelte avuaksak ding ua, a-umte ahihkek ding uh.
english: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will send to him those who pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles in pieces.

paite: Israel inkote'n amuanpi pen uh Bethel azahpih bang un Moab in Khemosh azahpihta ding hi.
english: Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.

paite: Pasal hoih leh galdou mihangsan i hi ua, bangchidan a chi na hi ua?
english: How do you say, We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war?

paite: Moab bel hihgawp in a-om a, akhopi meikhu in azam khinta, atangval hoih teng apuk khinta chih Kumpipa, amin Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Moab is laid waste, and they are gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Moab siatna ahong tung lellel, athuakna ding akinoh hi.
english: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

paite: Nou akim a mi teng in amah suun in amin thei teng in chiangkhun khauh leh chiang thupi akitanta hi, chi un.
english: All you who are around him, bemoan him, and all you who know his name; say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!

paite: Aw nang tanu, Dibon a teng, na thupina paisan inla, dangtak in tu in; Moab lokmi'n nang ahon sual a, na kulhte ahihseta hi.
english: You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you, he has destroyed your strongholds.

paite: Aw Aroer a teng nu, kongbul ah dingh in, enkhia in, taikekpa, suaktanu dong inla, Bang amaizen a? chi in.
english: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and watch: ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, What has been done?

paite: Moab zahlaksak in a-omta, achimgawpta ngal a, mau tuaituai in kap un, Moab hihsiat ahita! chih Arnon ah puang un.
english: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down: wail and cry; tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

paite: Gam tampi tung ah; Holon, Zahjah, Mephaath,
english: Judgment has come on the plain country, on Holon, and on Jahzah, and on Mephaath,

paite: leh Dibon, Nebo, Beth-diblathaim,
english: and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth Diblathaim,

paite: leh Keriathaim, Beth-gamul, Beth-menon,
english: and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth Gamul, and on Beth Meon,

paite: leh Kerioth, Bozrah leh Moab gam a khua tengteng, agamla leh anai ah vaihawmna ahong tungta hi.
english: and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

paite: Moab ki-attan in a-om a, aban hihtan in a-omta, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says Yahweh.

paite: Amah dawnkhamsak un; TOUPA tung ah akiliansak ngal a; huan, Moab bel amah luak ah akitholh ding a, nuihsan in a-om lai ding hi.
heading: Moab Hihniam Ahi Ding
english: Make him drunken; for he magnified himself against Yahweh: and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

paite: Israel nang ding nuihza bawlna ahita kei maw? Gutate lak ah atel a hia? Amah tungtang na gen teng in na lu na sinkhum hilou hiam?
english: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? was he found among thieves? for as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.

paite: Moab a tengte aw, khopite taisan unla, kawl kikal ah teng un, vakhu, kohawm gei a bu bawlsek bang in om un.
english: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock; and be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

paite: Moab kisaktheihna ka zata ua, akisathei ngut ve, akikoih sandan, akisaktheihdan, aki-otsakdan leh alungtang kideihkhopdante.
english: We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud; his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogance, and the haughtiness of his heart.

paite: Ahehna bangmah ahi kei chih ka thei; aki-otsaknate'n bangmah ahih ko kei, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I know his wrath, says Yahweh, that it is nothing; his boastings have worked nothing.

paite: Huchi in Moab tung ah ka mau tuaituai ding a, ahi, Moab pumpi a ding in ka kap ding, Kir-hareseth mite suun ahi ding uh.
english: Therefore will I wail for Moab; yes, I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir Heres shall they mourn.

paite: Jazer kap sang a thupi in ka hon kah ding a, aw Sibmah grep kung, na hiangte tuipi tung ah akiphalh a, Jazer tuipi leng atung hialta a, na nipithei leh grep gahte hihsemi in abawm hi.
english: With more than the weeping of Jazer will I weep for you, vine of Sibmah: your branches passed over the sea, they reached even to the sea of Jazer: on your summer fruits and on your vintage the destroyer is fallen.

paite: Nopna leh kipahna amang khin hi, theibil leh Moab gam a kipan; uain sukna khuk a ka uain ka beisakta a, kuamah in nuamsa a kikou in achil nawn kei ding uh.
english: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses: none shall tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.

paite: Heshbon leh Elealeh ah akikou ua, Jahaz tan in aw asuah ua, Zoar a kipan Horonaim tan, Eglath-shelishijah tan in leng, Nimrim tui kim adai ding hi.
english: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah: for the waters of Nimrim also shall become desolate.

paite: Huai lou in Moab mun sangte thil lanmi leh apathiante a dia gimlim halmi ka hihmang ding, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, says Yahweh, him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.

paite: Huchi in tamngai bang in ka lungtang Moab a ding in aging a, Kir-hareseth mite a ding in tumging bang in ka lungtang aging hi; huaiziak in niang-le-tai a thil amuhsate amangthang khinta hi.
english: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like pipes, and my heart sounds like pipes for the men of Kir Heres: therefore the abundance that he has gotten is perished.

paite: Lu chiteng metgiau ahi a, khamul chiteng met ahi; khut tengteng at ahi a; kongte ah sai-ip puan a-om chiat hi.
english: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped: on all the hands are cuttings, and on the waist sackcloth.

paite: Moab inn tung tengteng, kongzing leh mun chih ah kahna a-om a; Moab bel phatuam nawn lou bang in ka hihkham khinta hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: On all the housetops of Moab and in its streets there is lamentation every where; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which none delights, says Yahweh.

paite: Seta namai e! Segawp zou hi na tel e; Moab zahlak in alehngatta ve; huchi in Moab bel akimvel a mite tengteng a ding in nuihza bawlna leh mulkimhuai ahong hita hi.
english: How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So shall Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, mu bang in aleng ding a, Moab tung ah akha azak ding.
heading: Moab Asuakta Kei Ding
english: For thus says Yahweh: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.

paite: Kerioth lak ahi a, akulhte aphawng guih a, huai ni in Moab pasalphate lungtang numei nauvei lungtang bang mai ahi ding.
english: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and the heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

paite: Moab amangthang ding, nam aching nawn kei ding; TOUPA anuaisiah zawk ziak in.
english: Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.

paite: Launa, kokhuk leh tangte, aw Moab luahmi, na tung ah atung hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are on you, inhabitant of Moab, says Yahweh.

paite: Launa taisanmi kokhuk ah ake ding a, kokhuk a pawt thang ah a-awk ding, agawtna kum ka hon tun sin ngal a, atung ah, Moab tung ah ngei, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: He who flees from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation, says Yahweh.

paite: Heshbon lim ah taikekpawl bahgawp in akhawl ding ua, Heshbon a kipan in mei apawt a, Sihon lak a kipan in meikuang, chiak vengvung mite sip a sam toh Moab baksam akang khin hi.
english: Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire is gone forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

paite: Na tung agik hi, aw Moab! Khemosh mite amangta ua; na tapate sal a pi in, na tanute sal in atangta uhi.
english: Woe to you, O Moab! the people of Chemosh is undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.

paite: Himahleh ni nanung chiang in Moab omdan ka hei ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Hichi tan Moab tungthu ahi.
english: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
